note: Sign-in gate switches (src/waitlist-gate.ts), read once per process: change, merge, redeploy the api service. No expiry: each stays as set until this file changes. inviteRequired false (opened 2026-11-26): a verified Privy login with BOTH an X and a Google account is approved for trading without an invite code (approved_by 'open-signup'); X only, Google only, email or a wallet still need an invite code. accessCodeHash is sha256 (uppercase hex) of the view-only pass BBWCRE8 (shared openly with investors): the app lets whoever enters it browse without signing in; it approves nobody and grants no API access (POST /waitlist/gate only checks it). To turn invites back on: set inviteRequired to true. The view-only pass stays on unless accessCodeEnabled is false (or accessCodeHash is removed). People approved while open sign-up was on stay approved; revoke them from /operator if needed (revoked entries are never re-approved). A missing or malformed file means invites required and no view-only pass. GET /waitlist/gate tells the app both states.
